name: Uobishi Ryuuma
source:
At first glance he seems like an ordinary teacher but he secretly wishes subjugate and impregnate the girls of his school.
And with his new found power of hypnotism he aims to make her dream a reality.

Unusual Ability: Hypnotism
He is able to hypnotize anyone as long as he knows their 3 sizes.
